tender.title: A Bed Every Night (ABEN) rough sleepers' accommodation service Phase 6
tender.description:
ABEN provides accommodation for up to 33 people (including one emergency bed) who are sleeping rough, with six spaces assigned for individuals with No Recourse to Public Funds (NRPF). 
The service delivers support and housing management across three buildings, The Greater Manchester Combined Authority (GMCA) has confirmed its intention to continue funding theses services for a further 3 years. 
The most recent grant award runs from 1st April 2026 to 31st March 2029, with the funding amounts confirmed with the main 18-bed building operating as a 24-hour central hub. 
A Bed Every Night Phase 6 and RSI Outreach and Navigator services Procurement.
Value: £1,217,251.00

tender.title: Vigo Parish Council - Grounds Maintenance, Grass Cutting and Tree Works Contract
tender.description:
Vigo Parish Council invites tenders from suitably qualified and experienced contractors for the provision of grounds maintenance, grass cutting and tree works within the parish of Vigo, Kent.
The contract covers the maintenance of Parish Council owned land and public open spaces, including grass cutting, grassland management, tree and woodland maintenance, shrub and vegetation management, and associated grounds maintenance activities.
The contract will be for an initial period of four years, with the option to extend for two further periods of one year each, giving a maximum duration of six years.
The successful contractor will be required to provide suitably qualified personnel, appropriate equipment, effective supervision and emergency response arrangements in accordance with the Council's Service Specification.
Attendance at a pre-tender site visit is mandatory. Full details of the services, required standards, frequencies, contract conditions and tender evaluation criteria are provided in the tender documentation.
tender.submissionMethodDetails:
Tenders must be submitted electronically to 
tenders@vigo-pc.gov.uk 
by the deadline stated in this notice.
The dedicated tender mailbox will remain unopened until the submission deadline has passed. Late submissions will not be accepted.
All tender documents must be completed and submitted in accordance with the Invitation to Tender.
Clarification questions must be sent to clerk@vigo-pc.gov.uk, not to the tender submission address.
Council website: https://www.vigo-pc.gov.uk/Tender_Documents_44366.aspx

criteria.name: Price
criteria.description: Evaluation of the total tender price for the contract, in accordance with the pricing schedule and the evaluation methodology set out in the Invitation to Tender. Weighting: 35%.

criteria.name: Emergency response, resilience and ability to access Vigo
criteria.description: Assessment of the tenderer's ability to respond to urgent and emergency work, provide resilient service cover, and access Vigo reliably, including during adverse weather and other operational difficulties.

criteria.name: Experience and relevant track record
criteria.description: Assessment of relevant experience delivering comparable grounds maintenance, tree work and open-space services, supported by appropriate examples and references.

criteria.name: Staffing, resources and continuity
criteria.description: Assessment of staffing levels, supervision, equipment and other resources, together with arrangements for absence cover, continuity and maintaining the required service throughout the contract.

criteria.name: Quality and approach to service delivery
criteria.description: Assessment of the proposed approach to delivering the specification, maintaining appropriate standards of workmanship, managing environmental considerations and ensuring reliable service delivery.

criteria.name: Understanding of Vigo and the Contract
criteria.description: Assessment of the tenderer's understanding of Vigo's sites, local conditions, service requirements and practical challenges, and how these will be addressed when delivering the contract.

Tenderers must confirm that they have, or will obtain no later than 14 days before commencement of the Contract, public liability insurance of at least £10 million and employers' liability insurance where legally required.
Tenderers must also confirm that they have sufficient financial capacity to deliver the contract for its duration. The Council reserves the right to seek proportionate supporting evidence where reasonably necessary before making an award decision.
No audited accounts are required as a condition of participation.

Tenderers must demonstrate that they have the relevant experience, technical competence, staffing, resources and equipment necessary to deliver the grounds maintenance services described in the tender documents.
Tenderers must demonstrate appropriate health and safety competence, including the qualifications, training and experience necessary for any specialist activities, including tree work where applicable.
Tenderers must explain how they will provide sufficient staff, suitable plant and equipment (which may be owned or hired), and manage any subcontractors used to deliver the contract. The main contractor will remain responsible for the performance of subcontractors.
Tenderers must describe their approach to delivering the required quality of service and managing environmental considerations relevant to the contract.
Relevant experience and references must be provided as specified in the tender documents. Equivalent qualifications, standards and evidence will be accepted where appropriate.

renewal.description: The contract may be extended by up to two additional periods of one year each, following the initial four-year term. Each extension will be subject to the Parish Council's decision to exercise the relevant extension in accordance with the contract terms. The maximum total contract duration, including both extensions, will be six years.

lotDetails.noLotsDivisionRationale:
The Parish Council considered dividing the contract into separate lots for grounds maintenance, grass cutting and tree works. However, a single contract is considered more appropriate to provide a coordinated approach to the management and maintenance of Parish Council-owned land, ensure clear lines of responsibility, and reduce the administrative burden of managing multiple contracts.
The Council considers that a combined contract will support efficient service delivery, consistent standards and effective coordination of routine and emergency works. Subcontracting of specialist activities will be permitted, subject to the requirements of the contract.

contractTerms.financialTerms:
Vigo Parish Council will pay valid, undisputed invoices within 30 days of receipt, in accordance with the Procurement Act 2023.
Invoices must clearly identify the services provided and the relevant billing period. Any disputed invoices will be raised with the contractor for resolution.
